description: Source code for Xilinx AXI Timebase Watchdog Timer driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing watchdog functionality with configuration, setup, disable, timeout installation, and feeding mechanisms.

methods.name: wdt_xilinx_axi_setup
methods.description: Initializes and starts the watchdog timer with specified options.

methods.name: wdt_xilinx_axi_disable
methods.description: Disables the watchdog timer unless configured for one-time enable.

methods.name: wdt_xilinx_axi_install_timeout
methods.description: Configures the timeout period for the watchdog timer.

methods.name: wdt_xilinx_axi_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog to prevent expiry.
